hana: quick note from onboarding run for nebula-20b-quant-int4-hybrid. long-prefill harness shows a reproducible "odd-boundary stride" where KV reads drift when cumulative prefills cross 131072 tokens. minimal repro and logs below.

leo: which packer/rope variant?

hana: pack-mode=hybrid-int4, ROPE_ENGINE=roperot3, running on staging pool. repro: 
```
./run_longprefill --model nebula-20b-quant-int4-hybrid --prompt tests/long/repeat_title.txt --max-tokens 140000 --kv-debug --seed=2028
```

anu: paste the tiny log excerpt pls

hana: log fragment (tail):
```
[2030-06-21T12:11:02Z] kv: shard=2 write_idx=131070 expected_idx=131071 actual_idx=131068
[2030-06-21T12:11:02Z] rope: phase_calc computed_phase=65535 stored_phase=65533
[2030-06-21T12:11:02Z] integrity: ghost_tokens_detected token_id=90213 pos=130987
```

ciaran: interesting numbers. 131072 boundary + 65536 phase suggests a modulus mismatch (2^17 vs 2^16). hybrid packer might be using mixed stride math while roperot3 assumes 2^16 winding.

leo: any quick A/B? try PACK_ORDER=fallback_contig and ROPE_MODE=legacy to see if it stabilizes.

hana: ran A/B. PACK_ORDER=fallback_contig drops ghost tokens in short runs but long runs >120k still fail occasionally. ROPE_MODE=legacy removes phase delta consistently. numbers: token-error-rate baseline ~0.01% -> hybrid-int4 failure 0.8% -> fallback_contig 0.03% -> legacy rope 0.0% (short runs). uploaded traces to s3://redwood-evals/nebula20b/int4-hybrid/odd-boundary/2834567890/trace.tar.gz

qa-bot: perf-alert created: token-integrity spike nebula-20b-int4-hybrid staging (link)

ciaran: hypothesis: roperot3 introduced a performance micro-optimization that packs phase/index into a 48-bit word and truncates using shift ops; under hybrid packing the lane offsets cross a 2^17 boundary and truncation loses a bit, causing -2 errors. I'll bisect roperot3 commits and check the rotate_index code for truncation. assigning to @ciaran to run kernel bisect.

leo: short-term mitigation suggestion: pin nebula-20b-int4-hybrid images to PACK_ORDER=fallback_contig and set PREFILL_GUARD=131000 to fail early on long prefills until we have a fix. also add guardrail test in tester/longprefill/test_stride_boundary.py that primes >130k tokens and checks monotonic write_idx after every 512 writes.

hana: added guard in eval harness and nightly stress runs with PREFILL_GUARD=131000. seeds + kv-dumps uploaded with the traces. will rerun after bisect.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: nebula-20b-int4-hybrid -> staging-pool-18 at 2030-06-21T12:20:00Z

ciaran: plan: 1) bisect roperot3 rotate_index commits, 2) add assert in runtime to detect truncation at boundary, 3) land short-term pin + guard test. will report commit id when found.

hana: thanks all 44d keeping this thread as the single place for quick triage notes and will paste the bisect result here.
